# EfaPWA / Abfahrten

> Progressive Web App for real-time public transit departure monitoring in the Basel/Baden-Württemberg region (Germany/Switzerland).

Live instance: https://ov.b65.ch

## Tech Stack

- Vue 3.4 (Composition API, `<script setup>`), JavaScript ES Modules (no TypeScript)
- Vite 5.2, Pinia 2.1 (localStorage persistence), Vue Router 4.3
- Tailwind CSS 3.4 with iOS design system (`ios-blue`, `ios-gray`, `ios-dark`, `ios-secondary`, `ios-separator`)
- vite-plugin-pwa 0.20 + Workbox (NetworkFirst for EFA API, 60s TTL)
- External API: EFA Baden-Württemberg (`https://www.efa-bw.de/bvb3`), no auth required
- QR code support: `jsqr` (scan), `qrcode` (generate)

## Key Files

- `src/main.js` — App entry point, mounts Vue + Pinia + Router
- `src/App.vue` — Root component, applies dark mode class to `<html>`, renders `<router-view>` + `<BottomNav>`
- `src/router/index.js` — 4 routes: `/`, `/trip`, `/trip/detail`, `/settings`
- `src/views/HomeView.vue` — Departure board with auto-refresh and StopCard list
- `src/views/TripPlannerView.vue` — Journey planner with origin/destination search
- `src/views/TripDetailView.vue` — Trip itinerary detail view
- `src/views/SettingsView.vue` — Settings: dark mode, refresh interval, stop management
- `src/components/StopCard.vue` — Single stop card with skeleton loader, departures, countdown badges
- `src/components/BottomNav.vue` — Fixed bottom tab bar (3 tabs)
- `src/components/UpdatePrompt.vue` — PWA SW update prompt
- `src/services/efa.js` — All EFA API calls (pure functions): `searchStops`, `getDepartures`, `getAvailableLines`, `findNearestStop`, `resolveStopCoords`, `planTrip`, `getCountdownMinutes`, `filterDepartures`
- `src/stores/settings.js` — Pinia store: `stops[]`, `darkMode`, `refreshInterval`, `homeStop`, `stationHistory`
- `src/utils/lineColors.js` — Transit line badge colors by line name prefix and motType
- `vite.config.js` — Vite + VitePWA configuration
- `tailwind.config.js` — Tailwind config with iOS color tokens

## EFA API

Base URL: `https://www.efa-bw.de/bvb3`

| Endpoint | Function | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `XSLT_STOPFINDER_REQUEST` | `searchStops(query)` | Stop search by name |
| `XML_DM_REQUEST` | `getDepartures(stopId)` | Live departures (40 items, realtime) |
| `XML_DM_REQUEST` | `getAvailableLines(stopId)` | All lines/directions for a stop |
| `XML_DM_REQUEST` | `resolveStopCoords(stopId)` | Resolve coordinates for a known stopId |
| `XML_COORD_REQUEST` | `findNearestStop(lat, lon)` | Nearest stop to GPS coordinates |
| `XSLT_TRIP_REQUEST2` | `planTrip(originId, destId, dateTime, depArr)` | Plan a journey |

**Critical:** EFA returns a single object (not array) when only 1 result is found. Use `ensureArray()` from `efa.js`.
**Coordinate order:** EFA returns `"lon,lat"` strings — lon comes first.

## Data Structures

Stop object stored in Pinia:
```js
{ id: string, stopId: string, stopName: string, lat: number|null, lon: number|null, filters: Filter[] }
```

Filter object:
```js
{ id: string, line: string, direction: string }  // empty string = match all
```

## Code Conventions

- `<script setup>` in all Vue components
- No TypeScript, no test framework
- Tailwind utilities only (no custom CSS classes unless unavoidable)
- Dark mode via Tailwind `class` strategy
- All user-facing strings in German
- `async/await` over `.then()` chains
- `try/catch` in all service calls; local `ref()` for loading/error state in components

## Commands

```bash
npm run dev          # Vite dev server (all interfaces, HMR)
npm run build        # Production build → dist/
npm run preview      # Preview production build
npm run deploy       # Build + rsync (requires .env with RSYNC_DEST)
npm run generate-icons  # Regenerate PWA icons from icon.svg
```
